messages:
Alex: following the postmortem, here's a tight action list for the regional failover dry-run next week. short owners and ETA, please claim.
Rina: i'll own snapshot integrity + manifest checks and add an md5 compare script. aiming to land by Thu EOD.
Carlos: i'll take routing sanity and the pre-game route-diff job (bgp local-pref + prefix filters). due Thu EOD.
Alex: i'll coordinate rehearsal invites, reduce DNS TTLs, and add oncall overlap. planning a 60m rehearsal + 60m live dry-run.
Rina: note from last restore: WAL replay time wasn't captured. adding a step to measure WAL apply rate and include it in runbook.
Carlos: recurring pattern: route-preference flips during autoscale. i'll add a pre-check that compares current local-pref ordering vs baseline and fails if mismatch > 5%.
Alex: owners & short deliverables:
- Rina: snapshot_audit.sh + restore_runbook update (manifest, WAL check). due Thu EOD.
- Carlos: routing_sanity.sh + cron pre-check. due Thu EOD.
- Alex: schedule rehearsal, DNS TTL change, ops-bot reminders.
Carlos: pre-check snippet i'll add:
```
bgp-diff --baseline /opt/baselines/bgp.json --current /tmp/current.json || exit 1
```
Rina: manifest snippet:
```
aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-backups-prod --key snapshots/$(date -I)/manifest.json || exit 2
jq -r .checksums manifest.json | sha256sum -c - || exit 3
```
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: rehearsal Wed 09:00 PT; checklist will post 30m prior.
Alex: please respond with ":white_check_mark:" once you accept and add estimated hours on the postmortem board so SRE can staff. i'll move these into the tracker and close the thread.
Rina: :white_check_mark: 4h.
Carlos: :white_check_mark: 3h.
Alex: thanks all. closing thread and exporting items to the action tracker.
